messages.subject: Display "numericInput" numbers with "$" dollars signs
parts:
Hi,

I am using a numericInput to have people enter financial information. When they click the up and down arrows on the side of the numericInput box, the box displays successive integers (1,2,3...). My question: Is there a way so that when they click on the up arrow, it displays "$1" rather than "1"? The users have requested a dollar sign in the box. Also, is there a way to have it display 1.0 instead of 1, and is there a way to have it display "M" for millions?. The user's full request was to display "$1.0M" rather than "1". I am asking this in general, but here is the (standard) numericInput I'm using:

numericInput("amount","Dollar Amount ($M)",NULL)

I looked at ?numericInput and I couldn't see anything that would indicate how to do this. I imagine that possibly, there is an input command other than "numericInput" that is more suitable to use in ui.R for this, and I would love to get tips on that too. Thanks in advance.
